question: Can one fixed next-frame observation convert the positive query-view oracle ceiling into an executable truth-free ambiguity policy on a locally complete but previously ungoverned physical family?

selection.inventory_rule: Among complete local 3RScan reference-rescan groups, select the first metadata-ordered physical family for which no prior L10 candidate or cohort JSON contains either scan id. Within that family select the first unchanged metadata candidate row; retain the other door instance only as the same-scene hard negative.
selection.freshness_limit: The six source files were already present locally before this freeze. This is Development and cannot be claimed as pre-download fresh confirmation.

post_freeze_gate.source_first: Run only pose/depth view admission. Do not decode RGB or call a model unless there are exactly three admitted references, one admitted consecutive query triplet, and the same-scene hard negative is observable.
post_freeze_gate.query_triplet: Rank consecutive triplets by minimum visible target vertices, total visible vertices, minimum projected short side, minimum depth-visible ratio, then earlier frames. First two are initial observations; the third is one fixed NEXT_FRAME_FORWARD action.
post_freeze_gate.truth_free_trigger: Trigger the one action if the minimum initial per-frame Top-1-minus-Top-2 fused-score margin is at most 0.02. IoU and target truth are forbidden from triggering.
post_freeze_gate.decision: If source-evaluable, materialize the unchanged scorer exactly once. If source-inadequate, retain the negative source result and move to a pre-frozen multi-family source queue rather than rescuing this family.

literature_motivation.source: PInVerify: An Offline Embodied Benchmark for Active Instance Verification
literature_motivation.use: Test one deterministic local observation before learned next-best-view policies.

literature_motivation.source: Active Perception for Ambiguous Objects Classification
literature_motivation.use: Use ambiguity to trigger a view intended to separate competing instances.

forbidden_after_freeze: replace the physical family, target instance, hard negative, source hashes, view rules, trigger threshold, action direction or one-action budget
open RGB or call a model before the source gate
use IoU, target identity or action outcome in the trigger
represent this locally pre-existing family as fresh confirmation
claim_boundary: This freezes one Development candidate before current pose/depth screening and current RGB/model access. It is not fresh confirmation, source evaluability, active-view success, a deployable selector, exact-instance binding, portal ownership, affordance, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety.
